description:
Close a failed reply the coach has given up on, so it leaves the thread on every device. Sends nothing. Dismissing twice changes nothing.

Luca operation: POST /api/conversations/{id}/reply-failures/{failureId}/dismiss
Required scopes: conversations:write
Required OAuth scope: luca:queue_ops; data sensitivity: redacted
Does not require idempotency.
Use workspaceId or workspaceSlug to override the default workspace configured by environment.
name: luca_conversations_reply_failure_dismiss
title: Dismiss a failed reply
